column1: # Shaw (Rankov 2012 ch.8) Table 8.3: significant wave height H
# vs windspeed W (m/s relative to water)
# Source: Rankov 2012 p.72 (PDF page 84). Decoded via OCR (easyocr) of 8x render; values
# verified cell-by-cell against Carter 1982 duration-limited equations (see carter-equations.md).
# Legend: asterisk = sea has reached full development at that windspeed/duration/fetch.
# C measured relative to water moving at 0.5 m/s (1 knot). Wave with C above 3.9 m/s overtakes ship.
# Notes: W is wind RELATIVE to the water (true wind minus the 0.5 m/s favourable current).
# Shaw used Carter's T_z (zero-up-crossing period) convention; L = 1.56*Tz^2
